summary: Practise participant-record validation, contribution reconciliation and transaction controls. Explore the five-day intermediate course and its applied exercises
lede: Retirement plan recordkeeping uses documented checks to support accurate participant data, transactions and evidence trails. For plan administrators, recordkeeping specialists and benefits operations professionals, the course covers census-data validation, contribution reconciliation, and review of account, vesting and distribution records, with practical exercises in exception logging and control reporting.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who maintain retirement plan records, process participant transactions or review the controls that support accurate administration.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with retirement plan administration, employee benefits operations or participant records is expected. Programming is not required.
